Exclude selectors work in plain text output mode

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var optionsJson = "{\"exclude_selectors\":[\".nav\"],\"output_format\":\"Plain\"}";
        var options = JsonUtil.fromJson(optionsJson, ConversionOptions.class);
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<body><div class=\"nav\">Navigation</div><p>Article body</p></body>", options);
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
